perfil.title: About me
perfil.bio: Hi! I'm Lina Marcela Pérez, a digital journalist and content creator with experience in entertainment, fashion and beauty. My passion is to communicate and connect with people through authentic stories and innovative content. Through my work I've collaborated with many brands and artists, which has let me develop a strategic vision for creating high-impact content. My advanced command of English (C1) also lets me take my message to a wider audience.

periodista.title: My work as a journalist
periodista.text: Experience in digital content as a journalist, editor and script writer for RCN Radio and the live show XYZ. I tell stories that connect, with editorial judgment and a voice of my own on camera.

campo.text: Live event coverage: concerts, TV premieres, red carpets and festivals like Premios Nuestra Tierra and MasterChef Celebrity. I report from the scene, with energy and closeness.
